Option1Stmt.S: change in internal energy is zero

Option3Stmt.S: change in internal energy is not zero

Solution.S: In an isobaric process, pressure is constant. Volume and temperature can change, so internal energy changes (since it depends on temperature). Work done is not zero ($W = P\Delta V$). Heat is not zero unless it's adiabatic. Thus, the correct statement is that change in internal energy is not zero. Hence, the correct option is C.
